name: Negative Mass Ingot
lore: Push it and it comes toward you.

name: Spacetime Alloy Ingot
lore: An alloy of matter and curved space. Its reflection shows distant stars.

name: Stellar Iron Ingot
lore: Iron from the core of a star - the end of fusion. Making anything heavier costs energy instead of releasing it.

name: Unbihexium Ingot
lore: Element 126, the heart of the island of stability. Nothing should be this heavy and last this long.

name: Mirror Alloy Ingot
lore: Matter and antimatter in alternating grains, a Penning field between every pair. It hums.

name: Proof of Everything
lore: What Alpha Omega left behind: a proof that you understood. The Transcendental opens only to it.

name: Spacetime Catalyst
lore: A self-sustaining knot of curved spacetime. Required (not consumed) by hyperdimensional processes.

name: Fractal Core
lore: The smallest copy of a Fractal Wyrm. It is also the largest.

name: M-Theory Core
lore: Eleven dimensions, and all five string theories turn out to be one.

name: Quark Star Core
lore: The heart of a star too dense even for neutrons.

name: Planck Shard
lore: 1.6 x 10^-35 m. You cannot cut it smaller.

name: Superposition Crystal
lore: Exists in several lattice configurations simultaneously.
